name: Pátroclo
type: Asteroid · Jupiter Trojan · L5 · P-type · Binary primary
fact: Primary of the largest known binary in the Jupiter Trojans — 113-km Patroclus paired with the 104-km Menoetius at a mutual separation of 680 km. The Iliadic pairing is deliberate: Patroclus and Menoetius are Achilles' beloved companion and his father, the two who in the epic fall together.
bio: Discovered 1906, classified as a P-type with low-albedo, reddish reflectance. Lucy's 2033-03-02 encounter at 8.4 km/s closes the primary mission — the spacecraft will image both partners of the binary in one approach, mapping the surface terrain, composition, and the gravitational dance that has bound them through 4.5 Gyr.
